about_the_game:
Ever wished you could play your favorite local multiplayer games with friends across the globe? Game Together makes it possible! This innovative tool allows you to launch any local co-op game and seamlessly connect with friends via Steam's Remote Play Together feature. Whether you're reliving classic couch co-op experiences or discovering new multiplayer gems, Game Together ensures that distance is no longer a barrier to fun.

Features

  • Easy Start: Quickly launch and connect local multiplayer games via Steam's Remote Play Together.

  • Hassle-Free Setup: No complicated network configurations—just invite, play, and enjoy!

  • Auto-Start Apps: Streamline the experience by automatically launching required applications.

  • Game Status Display: (Coming Soon!) Show which game is currently being played directly in Steam.

  • Universal Compatibility: Works with a vast selection of local co-op and split-screen games.

  • Revive the Classics: Play legendary couch co-op games online with friends, as if you were side by side.

No need for third-party setups—just start the game, invite your friends, and play together as if you were in the same room!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit / Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3225 / AMD A10-7850K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750Ti(2GB) / AMD Radeon R7 370(2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit / Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060(3GB) / AMD Radeon RX570(4GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Game Together lets you play local multiplayer games online via Steam's Remote Play Together. Easily launch games, auto-start required apps, and soon display in-game status on Steam. No setup hassle—just invite, play, and enjoy couch co-op from anywhere!
